data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'qan' which means 'to be intelligent, wise and knowledgeable'. The name Qani is bestowed upon a child who is believed to possess these qualities. historical_references.reference: Al-Qani al-Dimashqi was a renowned Islamic scholar, jurist, and theologian from Damascus, Syria, who lived during the 13th century. He is famous for his works in fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence) and kalam (Islamic theology), and his contributions to the development of the Hanafi school of thought.
